# sigma_tenant_deployment_capability (Resource)

Allows a tenant organization to deploy content to another tenant organization. Composite ID `<tenant_organization_id>:<deploy_to_tenant_organization_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Let the "hub" tenant deploy content to the "acme" tenant.
resource "sigma_tenant_deployment_capability" "hub_to_acme" {
  tenant_organization_id           = sigma_tenant.hub.id
  deploy_to_tenant_organization_id = sigma_tenant.acme.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deploy_to_tenant_organization_id` (String) Tenant organization it may deploy to.
- `tenant_organization_id` (String) Tenant organization that is granted the capability.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_tenant_deployment_capability.example '<tenant_organization_id>:<deploy_to_tenant_organization_id>'
```
